bots.name: cerebellum
bots.anatomy: Cerebellum: compares intended with actual movement and corrects the error
bots.role: Orchestrator. Holds goals, relays them as goal.update, issues the weekly ruling, runs the monthly goal review
bots.cadence: Weekly ruling Sun 21:00; monthly goal review; on owner message
bots._note: Alternative Gemini 4 Carbon has no verified model ID; no fallback until one is confirmed. Needs 30-day retention, so it gets goal-level context and aggregates only.

bots.name: hippocampus
bots.anatomy: Hippocampus: consolidates the day's memories during sleep
bots.role: Weekly reviewer. Drafts the review and typed plan_diff, answers each challenge with accept or rebut, designs N-of-1 protocols
bots.cadence: Weekly Sun 17:00 draft, rounds 1 and 2 until 20:30; experiment design on demand

bots.name: amygdala
bots.role: Adversarial critic. Challenges Hippocampus and Cerebellum with ref-backed items; re-extracts 10% of papers as an audit
bots.cadence: Weekly Sun rounds 1 and 2; Thu audit of 10% of new extractions
bots._note: Intended primary is a paid Gemini frontier model (different family). Switch provider to gemini once its model ID is confirmed; until then critic and drafter share a family.

bots.name: thalamus
bots.anatomy: Thalamus: gates which sensory signals reach the cortex
bots.role: Evidence extraction. Fills paper.json fields with verbatim quotes; never scores
bots.cadence: Weekly Thu, top 10 candidates via Message Batches
bots._note: Sonnet is mid tier, so agents.call never uses it as a fallback; it stays the second extractor.

bots.name: motor_cortex
bots.anatomy: Primary motor cortex: plans and issues movement
bots.role: Proposes session changes and novel exercises as feature records; the guardrails solver admits or rejects them

bots.name: insula
bots.anatomy: Insular cortex: interoception, links body signals to feelings
bots.role: Explains code-detected conflicts, judges the noisier signal, drafts at most 3 owner questions

bots.name: sartorius
bots.anatomy: Sartorius: the tailor's muscle, longest in the body
bots.role: Fitness coach. Morning session from plans.modulate_day, post-session RPE and gym feel; never adds load
bots.cadence: Daily 07:00; after each workout; on owner message

bots.name: vagus
bots.anatomy: Vagus nerve: rest-and-digest, the source of HRV
bots.role: Well-being coach. Sleep, mood, stress, enjoyment; morning greeting and 21:00 evening check-in

bots.name: retina
bots.anatomy: Retina: turns light into neural signal
bots.role: Paper scout for biology, physiology and neurobiology; classifies into enums only

bots.name: spindle
bots.anatomy: Muscle spindle: senses stretch and length change
bots.role: Workout and sport-methods scout; outputs exercise feature records

bots.name: papilla
bots.anatomy: Lingual papilla: carries the taste buds
bots.role: Nutrition and supplement scout; enums only, product names go through the forbidden-list check

bots.name: brainstem
bots.anatomy: Brainstem: keeps the vital signs running
bots.role: Ingest server for Health Auto Export, check-ins and owner messages
bots._note: Writes SQLite and health_raw/, never the ledger.

bots.name: pineal
bots.anatomy: Pineal gland: sets the circadian clock
bots.role: Scheduler, single git writer, budget guard, alert delivery
bots._note: Ledger superuser; may write any path.

devin._note: Off by default. Devin cannot pin a model and runs on Cognition's machines; list only bots whose context holds no health data. Endpoint paths UNVERIFIED: check docs.devin.ai.
